## Requirements (from the spec)

1. One version source (G3 §9.3): every package `__version__ =
   importlib.metadata.version("<dist>")`; a `make check` test asserts
   each pyproject version = `__version__` = `web/package.json` version,
   none `0.0.0`.
2. `scripts/bump_version.py <x.y.z>` bumps all 14 packages + web
   together; dry-run default; test runs it on a temp copy.
3. `resolver_version` = `resolution` package version + `+g<commit8>`,
   never the exports placeholder (G3 §3.2 ★; the 09-27 manifest reads
   `0.0.0`).
4. CHANGELOG discipline (G3 §9.4): `## [Unreleased]` split into
   Keep-a-Changelog sections, entries naming ticket + requirement ids;
   a CI check in the `docs` job fails a PR touching the listed
   public-behaviour paths without a CHANGELOG change unless a commit
   carries `Changelog: none (<reason>)`.
5. Tag procedure + template: annotated tag
   `git tag -a v0.N.0 <sha> -m "<CHANGELOG section>"` (operator action,
   tag object carries the true date → no typed date);
   `docs/build/reports/releases/TAG_TEMPLATE.md` (tree hash, green CI
   run ids, included PRs, production release labels from the range);
   the `v0.1.0` TAG file for the #141–#190 sitting prepared, marked
   "not tagged — operator action" (OP-08).
